articles.title: Justin Jefferson Explains Why Odell Beckham Jr. is His Role Model in Video Ahead of 2026 NFL Season
articles.summary: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson clearly has great respect for New York Giants wideout (and fellow ex-LSU Tiger superstar) Odell Beckham Jr., based on his remarks to Taylor Rooks during Boardroom's September cover story.
articles.body:
Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson clearly has great respect for New York Giants wideout (and fellow ex-LSU Tiger superstar) Odell Beckham Jr., based on his remarks to Taylor Rooks during Boardroom's September cover story.

During the interview, Rooks asked Jefferson which wide receiver he watched was the best showman. Jefferson responded as follows (14:25 mark).

"Odell. 100 percent. Odell was No. 1," Jefferson said.

"The swagger, his hair, from everybody dying the hair blonde, from the dance moves that he was doing, from the swag, obviously being in New York. He's the nationally televised person, of course, doing the things that he has doing. The one handers, all of those different things that kind of played the part. And he was a big time playmaker. And he was my brother coming from LSU, so it was just kind of a family tie in that aspect, and to see him doing the things that he has done in the league, it was just already topping it off. So, I mean, he's pretty much the most famous football player."

Beckham burst onto the NFL scene in 2014 and quickly became one of the league's most popular players thanks in part to his tremendous skills. He arguably had the best hands in football, as evidenced by the iconic one-handed touchdown catch against the Dallas Cowboys during his rookie year.

Over his first three seasons, Beckham averaged 96 catches, 1,374 receiving yards and 12 touchdowns. He won Associated Press Offensive Rookie of the Year honors and made the All-Pro Second Team in 2015 and 2016.

Beckham has still had his fair share of moments since then, although serious injuries have unfortunately sidelined him for long periods of time. Still, he's one of the most beloved pass-catchers in recent memory and is now authoring a great comeback story after making the Giants' 53-man roster following a year away from the game.

It's clear Beckham has served as a role model for Jefferson, who continued to talk about how much he reveres the Giant.

During the interview, Rooks said the following after Jefferson called him the most famous football player.

"Because he transcended in a lot of ways to your point," Rooks said. "The fashion he had, the hair, and similar to you, there's just parts about him that are a statement, like it is unique to being Odell."

"That's what makes him him," Jefferson answered.

"It's nothing that anybody can do to imitate that. 'Cause that's what makes him him. You try to imitate it as much as you can, from the swagger, just the vibes when you're around him, you can just feel the energy.

"Exactly," Jefferson noted. "You just want to smile when you're around him. You just want to be goofy and just want to be just have him as a friend. That's always something that I kind of looked at him as, but he's definitely that guy that kind of turned on that switch for me, and it's more than football, it's more of an entertainment. It's more of giving the fans what they want to see because that's what makes you more of a superstar. And it's a full package. You can't be a superstar by just balling on the field. You gotta be a superstar on and off the field. You gotta be that person that people want to put on TV, and you see, 'Oh, yeah, that's Justin Jefferson. He's hitting the Griddy.' That's something I've always kind of thought about, that I've always tried to center myself around, having that good image, having that superstar ability and having that entertainment piece as well. So it's a whole full circle."

Jefferson has made a major mark on the NFL in his own right, amassing 1,000-yard seasons in all six of his pro campaigns. He's a four-time All-Pro (two first teams, two second teams) who won AP Offensive Player of the Year honors as well.

Both Jefferson and Beckham start their seasons at home on Sunday. Jefferson and the Vikings will play the Green Bay Packers at 4:25 p.m. ET, and Beckham and the Giants will host the Dallas Cowboys for Sunday Night Football (8:20 p.m.).

articles.title: CeeDee Lamb Drops Confident Quote on Cowboys Expectations for 2026 NFL Season
articles.summary: Several members of the Dallas Cowboys have expressed high expectations for the 2026 campaign, and wide receiver CeeDee Lamb joined his teammates on Thursday.
articles.body:
Several members of the Dallas Cowboys have expressed high expectations for the 2026 campaign, and wide receiver CeeDee Lamb joined his teammates on Thursday.

Lamb said he wants the team "to proclaim dominance" this year.

"I want us to proclaim dominance. I want us to be who we think we are, and overall, only so many words can be said," Lamb told reporters . "And I'm very — I want to put it into action."

Perhaps nobody on the Cowboys has been more confident about winning it all than quarterback Dak Prescott.

"I'm not going to shy away from [Super Bowl talk]," he told reporters at the start of training camp. "Why not now?"

Prescott said he's been manifesting a Super Bowl, setting alarms on his phone labeled "Super Bowl 61." While every team is confident they can win it all, it's a bit taboo to openly discuss taking home a championship the way Prescott has. He has no problem with what outsiders say.

"Why are we hesitant to say that that's what we're playing for?" Prescott said, per Sports Illustrated's Albert Breer in August. "I don't know if it's just getting older, having kids and blatantly not giving a f--k what other people think, but if that's what this is about, then why is anybody being hesitant about it? And why is it, honestly, such a big deal even saying it? So my point is, let's put it out there. Like, I'm a big manifester. I wouldn't be here in my life if I didn't think I would be here, going back to being a little kid."

Prescott also told Yahoo Sports' Jori Epstein last month that he's "as urgent as I've ever felt" to win a Super Bowl.

The Cowboys are in a long Super Bowl drought, having not reached the NFC Championship Game since they won it all in 1995. But it's easy to see why Prescott and others are so confident heading into the season.

Dallas had one of the best offenses in the league last year with Prescott, Lamb and George Pickens thriving together, and that won't be any different this year. The Cowboys also bolstered their defense this offseason after that unit posted rough numbers in 2025.

Dallas has plenty of competition to even reach the Super Bowl, but its roster is more than capable of making a run.

It all starts Sunday in New York, where the Cowboys are 2.5-point favorites against the Giants, per FanDuel Sportsbook .

articles.title: Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes Drops Hype Video Ahead of Return from Knee Injury, 'See Ya Monday'
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes released a new hype video narrated by rapper BigXthaPlug ahead of his 2026 season debut in a Thursday post on Instagram.
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes released a new hype video narrated by rapper BigXthaPlug ahead of his 2026 season debut in a Thursday post on Instagram .

"See you Monday," Mahomes wrote in the caption of the post.

The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback is set to be back under center for the first time since suffering a torn ACL in Week 15 of the 2025 season.

Mahomes' recovery has been impressive, as his upcoming Week 1 appearance will be just nine months after the injury occurred. He plans to wear a brace during the contest.

Chiefs head coach Andy Reid confirmed that the team won't use an altered game plan, as the two-time MVP has been active in training camp.

"He's shown he can do [everything]," Reid said Thursday, per ESPN's Nate Taylor . "We won't hold anything back that we wouldn't normally. He's geared up and ready to go. It's just a matter of getting out there and playing.

"I know he's excited to get going. It's been hard for him to sit there and watch. That's not his style. I'm sure he'll be fired up to get out there and finally be able to play, especially [because of] the hard work he put into it."

During the 2025 season, Mahomes completed 62.7 percent of his throws for 3,587 yards and 22 touchdowns compared to 11 interceptions. He also rushed for 422 yards and five scores.

The Chiefs fell short of expectations both with and without Mahomes, owning a 6-8 record in his 14 starts before finishing at 6-11 overall. It was a disappointing result for a Kansas City squad that has won three Super Bowl titles and made several deep playoff runs throughout the signal-caller's tenure with the organization.

Now, Mahomes and the Chiefs will face the Denver Broncos to begin their 2026 campaign. Kickoff is on Monday at 8:15 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Aaron Rodgers can't guarantee post-retirement return to Green Bay, hints at lingering tension with 'certain people in the building'
articles.summary: Rodgers believes that there are people in the Packers facility who wouldn't entirely welcome a reunion: "Maybe I wouldn't be on board if they were still ther...
articles.body:
Aaron Rodgers is entering his fourth season away from the Green Bay Packers . He faced them last season; however, that game took place in Pittsburgh , where he's now going into Year 2 as the Steelers ' QB1 and Year 22 as an NFL signal-caller.

Rodgers is on the record saying 2026 will be his final season in the league, and the Steelers don't have the Packers on the regular-season docket this time around.

But what about a post-retirement return to Green Bay for Rodgers? After all, despite the tense ending to his illustrious 18-season tenure with the organization, he won the Packers their most recent Super Bowl during the 2010 season and collected NFL MVP honors in 2011, 2014, 2020 and 2021.

Rodgers, though, can't guarantee a reunion right now. He conveyed that uncertainty during a "Wilde and Tausch" interview that aired Thursday on ESPN Milwaukee/Madison radio.

A month after Rodgers said he'd need an invitation before making his way back to Lambeau Field in a non-playing capacity , he was asked if he has any reason to doubt that the Packers would invite him to Green Bay.

"I think there's some people that have a lot of affection for me, and I would assume, we're talking four or five years from now, that there'll be fans who still have appreciation for what I've done, especially after so much time has passed," Rodgers said.

"But I think there's certain people in the building who wouldn't be totally on board, and maybe I wouldn't be on board if they were still there as well."

It's unclear who exactly Rodgers meant by "certain people in the building."

That said, earlier in the interview, Rodgers expressed dissatisfaction regarding one individual. He did so while reflecting on his final chapter with the Packers.

Eerily similar to how Green Bay grabbed Rodgers in the first round of the 2005 draft to eventually supplant a veteran Brett Favre, the franchise scooped up Jordan Love in the first round of the 2020 draft with the intention of someday replacing Rodgers.

Rodgers promptly won back-to-back MVP awards under head coach Matt LaFleur, extending his time in Green Bay before regressing during an injury-riddled 2022 season, his final go-around with the Packers.

Jason Wilde inquired during the exclusive interview to see if there's anything Rodgers thinks he could have done differently in that 2022 campaign, aside from avoiding a broken thumb in London amid a Week 5 loss to the New York Giants .

"Yeah, for sure. I mean, there's definitely some things that I could have done obviously to make those guys a little more comfortable, I guess," Rodgers said in reference to the young wide receivers the Packers ushered in that year.

"But the GM wanted me out of there, so it was only a matter of time. They just were looking for one non-MVP season, and that was going to be that. I understand it. Didn't necessarily agree with it, but I understand."

Rodgers added: "I just didn't like the way it was handled, and obviously I could have probably handled it better but, on the flip side, probably made it a little bit easier for Jordan."

The general manager Rodgers spoke of in that quote is Brian Gutekunst. He took over for Ted Thompson in 2018 and has maintained the role of GM since, pulling the trigger to take Love in his third draft calling the shots.

"Honestly, it really made me know that the end was going to come at some point, probably before I wanted it to, in Green Bay," Rodgers said of the Packers selecting Love. "I always talked about playing my entire career there, like Kobe Bryant [with the Los Angeles Lakers], Tim Duncan [with the San Antonio Spurs], the Derek Jeters [who played for the New York Yankees], some iconic players. And I realized at that point that I was probably going to have to play somewhere else, at least a year or two.

"But I've always felt like you can bring almost anybody in, and I'd love to compete with them. I haven't seen anybody that's been clearly better than me in the quarterback room since 2007."

There appeared to be a strain on Rodgers' relationship with Gutekunst down the stretch of his stay in Green Bay, including when Rodgers skipped the team's 2021 offseason program and then voiced his desire to be more involved in franchise decisions.

Even so, it's worth noting that, according to ESPN , Gutekunst said on "The Rich Eisen Show" last year that he roots for Rodgers and added that "there's so much appreciation for him from our organization and from myself."

articles.title: Sam Darnold Injury Status Updated by Seahawks HC Mike Macdonald After Early Exit vs. Patriots
articles.summary: Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury just five snaps into the Seattle Seahawks' season opener against the New England Patriots on Wednesday, but head coach Mike Macdonald offered a positive update on Thursday.
articles.body:
Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury just five snaps into the Seattle Seahawks' season opener against the New England Patriots on Wednesday, but head coach Mike Macdonald offered a positive update on Thursday.

Macdonald said on Seattle Sports 710 AM that Darnold's hip is intact and the injury appears to be muscular. He didn't offer a timetable on the quarterback, though.

"Now, how long that [he's out], we don't know yet," Macdonald said (h/t ESPN's Brady Henderson ). "But really, really good news. So we're really happy for Sam. That's good. But it is painful, though. I know it hasn't been an easy night for him."

According to NFL insider Tom Pelissero, tests on Darnold showed "an unusual muscle strain in his hip area" and his timetable to return is to be determined. There has been no consideration of a stint on injured reserve at this point, per Pelissero.

That said, Drew Lock is the "likely" start for a Week 2 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.

On their first drive of the season, Darnold took a sack from New England's Dre'Mont Jones on third down. He went to the medical tent and was later ruled out for the contest, being replaced by Lock.

After leaving the game, Darnold underwent a CT scan on his hip at Harborview Medical Center in Seattle, but it came back inconclusive. Luckily, Macdonald told reporters after the game that Darnold had avoided a hip fracture.

NFL Network's Ian Rapoport said Thursday that Darnold is "expected to miss next week's game, but he should be back sooner rather than later." Rapoport added that Darnold could miss "just a few weeks."

Darnold, who joined the Seahawks ahead of the 2025 campaign, had a tremendous first year in Seattle, throwing for 4,048 yards, 25 touchdowns and 14 interceptions while completing 67.7 percent of his passes.

He led the Seahawks to a Super Bowl victory after throwing for 672 yards and five touchdowns in the postseason.

But after years of avoiding injury, Darnold is now seemingly set to miss at least one game and possibly more. That means Lock will continue to have to hold it down under center for the defending champs.

Lock, a career backup like Darnold once was, had a decent showing in Wednesday's game. While he didn't light up the box score, he managed the game well as neither team managed to find the end zone much.

The 29-year-old finished with 187 yards and a touchdown on 16-of-22 passing.

"You just feel the poise, the calm," Macdonald said of Lock. "He's just a confident guy, as he should be, because he's got the body of work to back it up. He's got the teammates that support him and believe in him, too."

Seattle could also have Jalen Milroe available against the Cardinals next week. The former third-round pick in 2025 was listed as the team's emergency third-string quarterback on Wednesday, so he could only come in if Lock were injured.

articles.title: Jeremiyah Love Updates Injury Status for Cardinals vs. Chargers, Fantasy Outlook for NFL Week 1
articles.summary: Arizona Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love could be making his regular-season NFL debut Sunday despite a lingering ankle injury.
articles.body:
Arizona Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love could be making his regular-season NFL debut Sunday despite a lingering ankle injury.

Love told reporters Thursday he would be willing to play in this weekend's season opener against the Los Angeles Chargers even if his injured ankle isn't "100 percent."

"I expect to do whatever the coaches want me to do. They want to put me out there, I'm gonna go out there and play, whether my ankle feels 100 percent, 50 percent, 70 percent," Love said (h/t PHNX Sports' Bo Brack).

Love also told reporters his ankle is "getting better every single day," per Brack .

Love suffered a high ankle sprain Aug. 13. He was most recently listed as a limited participant in the Cardinals' Thursday and Friday practices.

Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that regardless of official practice designations there was "no limit on our end" in terms of Love's participation.

Love said Thursday he has been trying "to do more than what they wanted me to do" since suffering the injury in a preseason matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders.

"When I first injured it, they wanted to put me in a boot," Love said (h/t Brack). "I'm like, 'Nah, I just want to walk around. I want to feel it out and do my own thing.' But the trainers, they know what's best."

He aded he has "full trust" in the Cardinals to guide his recovery, per Brack .

LaFleur has given non-specific but positive updates on Love throughout the week leading up to the season opener.

When asked Monday is he was optimistic Love had a chance to play, LaFleur answered , "Yeah, I feel good."

LaFleur said when asked Wednesday for an update the team planned to "just kind of take it one day at a time" with Love.

The Cardinals listed Love behind Tyler Allgeier on the Cardinals' unofficial Week 1 depth chart , but LaFleur said Wednesday he didn't think that order was worth looking "too far into."

Love said Thursday he trusts LaFleur to create an "explosive" offense designed around players' specific skillsets.

Allgeier might take a larger share of the workload early in the season, especially if Love is limited by his injury. The chance Love will get more carries when healthy should still make fantasy managers consider holding on to the rookie running back despite his uncertain Week 1 status.

articles.title: Sam Darnold reportedly has 'unusual' muscle strain around hip, avoided feared fractured hip socket
articles.summary: Darnold will seek further opinions on the injury, per the report, but injured reserve is not being considered at this point.
articles.body:
News keeps dropping regarding Sam Darnold 's hip injury, and it continues to be relatively positive for the Seattle Seahawks quarterback.

Netflix's NFL Insider Tom Pelissero reported Thursday night that tests revealed Darnold has "an unusual muscle strain in his hip area."

Per the report, the Seahawks initially feared that Darnold had sustained a fractured hip socket that could have threatened his season. Testing ruled that injury out.

Darnold will seek further opinions on the injury, per the report, but injured reserve is not being considered at this point. As previously reported , Drew Lock is expected to start in Week 2 against the Arizona Cardinals . Beyond that, Darnold's game status is unclear.

Lock took over at quarterback after Darnold's injury on the first drive Wednesday night and led a 13-10 comeback win over the New England Patriots in the NFL's season opener.

Darnold sustained the injury on a sack that ended Seattle's first drive of the season. Darnold limped off the field on his own, but entered a sideline medical tent on the ensuing Patriots possession.

Drew Lock took over at quarterback on the next Seattle possession, and the Seahawks eventually ruled Darnold out for the remainder of the game. Head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters after the game that Darnold required further testing, but the Seahawks "we are able to rule out a fracture."

Without Darnold, Seattle's offense managed enough production behind an efficient effort from Lock without any major mistakes. Lock finished the game completing 16 of 22 passes for 187 yards with one touchdown and no turnovers. He delivered the ball to Seattle's top offensive weapon, Jaxon Smith-Njigba , who finished the game with eight catches for 122 yards and Seattle's only touchdown.

Behind the strength of their defense and playmakers on offense, the Seahawks won a Super Bowl last season without requiring Darnold to be spectacular. They'll look for the same type of mistake-limited game management from Lock until Darnold is able to return to the field.

articles.title: A.J. Brown Injury Timeline Revealed in New NFL Rumors After Patriots Star's Ankle Sprain
articles.summary: The New England Patriots will reportedly be without wide receiver A.J. Brown for at least a month after he suffered an ankle injury during Wednesday's season-opening loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
articles.body:
The New England Patriots will reportedly be without wide receiver A.J. Brown for at least a month after he suffered an ankle injury during Wednesday's season-opening loss to the Seattle Seahawks.

NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported Thursday an MRI confirmed Brown suffered a high-ankle sprain and is expected to miss at least four weeks.

"Ankle sprains are generally four-to-six [weeks], it will depend on how he is healing," Rapoport said.

NFL insider Jordan Schultz provided more context to the situation:

Brown was one of New England's marquee additions this offseason, and expectations were quite high entering his first game with the team.

He got off to a solid start when he drew a pass interference penalty that helped set up a touchdown, but he exited in the third quarter with three catches for 26 yards when he suffered the injury going for a pass.

While Brown was expected to be the go-to receiver for quarterback Drake Maye this season, he wasn't the only notable offseason addition at the position. The Patriots also added Romeo Doubs, although the former Green Bay Packers did not get off to an ideal start during Wednesday's loss to Seattle.

Doubs finished without a catch on three targets and had a critical drop as the visitors lost a 10-0 lead in the second half.

Ultimately, New England reached the Super Bowl last season without Brown. It has enough talent to tread water and remain on the short list of the AFC's best teams while he is out, and it will be up to Doubs, Mack Hollins and DeMario Douglas at wide receiver until the No. option returns.

The next five games for the Patriots are against AFC foes in the Pittsburgh Steelers, Jacksonville Jaguars, Buffalo Bills, Las Vegas Raiders and New York Jets. Games against Las Vegas and New York seem like opportunities to pick up wins, but the Steelers, Jaguars and Bills all made the playoffs last season.

Maye and Co. will need to figure out a way to adjust without Brown for what could prove to be a critical stretch in the AFC playoff race.

articles.title: Ty Simpson Inactive for Week 1 vs. 49ers, 1st-Round NFL Draft Pick is Rams' QB3 Behind Bennett

articles.title: 49ers vs. Rams: Everything You Need to Know for the NFL’s Historic Australia Game
articles.summary: The NFL is officially going Down Under. The San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams meet Thursday night at Melbourne Cricket Ground in the first regular-sea...
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams meet Thursday night at Melbourne Cricket Ground in the first regular-season NFL game ever played in Australia. More than 100,000 fans are expected at the MCG.

Matchup: San Francisco 49ers vs. Los Angeles Rams

Location: Melbourne Cricket Ground — Melbourne, Australia

Netflix pregame: 6:30 p.m. ET / 3:30 p.m. PT

U.S. TV: KNTV in the Bay Area and KNBC in Los Angeles

Australia: ESPN via Kayo Sports/Foxtel and Disney+

Radio: SiriusXM NFL Radio, plus each team's local radio network

The game is not on Amazon Prime Video . Netflix has the U.S. streaming rights for this historic matchup.

Both clubs finished 12-5 last season , making this more than a novelty international matchup.

The Rams return essentially their entire elite 2025 offense, led by reigning MVP Matthew Stafford , Puka Nacua and Davante Adams . Los Angeles also added All-Pro edge rusher Myles Garrett .

San Francisco counters with Brock Purdy , Christian McCaffrey , George Kittle and Nick Bosa . Kittle and Bosa are among the notable 49ers who are active after dealing with injuries.

The biggest subplot might be how differently these teams approached Australia.

The 49ers arrived roughly a week before the game to acclimate to the 16-hour flight and massive time difference.

Los Angeles arrived only about 28 hours before kickoff .

The Rams actually sent players to Australia earlier this year to test different travel strategies before settling on the plan.

And it is the beginning of the NFL's record nine-game international schedule across seven countries in 2026.

The Jonas Brothers will also perform during halftime.

So, basically, the NFL is throwing an NFC West rivalry into the world's most famous cricket stadium and turning it into a global event.

If you're watching tonight, Netflix is the place to be.

articles.title: Baltimore Ravens Predicted to Make Major Leap in 1 Key Category
articles.summary: The Baltimore Ravens could be on the verge of a major defensive turnaround in 2026, with one bold prediction placing their revamped unit among the NFL’s best...
articles.body:
The Baltimore Ravens could be on the verge of a major defensive turnaround in 2026, with one bold prediction placing their revamped unit among the NFL's best . After a disappointing stretch on defense last season, the expectation is that Baltimore can make a significant leap in takeaways and overall disruption.

The biggest reason for optimism is the arrival of head coach Jesse Minter, whose system is expected to bring a different approach to the unit. Minter has a reputation for creating pressure through multiple looks and putting defenders in positions to attack, something that could help Baltimore generate more turnovers while limiting explosive plays.

The Ravens already have several pieces capable of thriving in an aggressive scheme. Kyle Hamilton remain s one of the league's most versatile defensive backs, and his ability to line up across the formation gives the defense a valuable chess piece. Pairing that flexibility with an improved pass rush could create more opportunities for interceptions, forced fumbles and short fields for the offense.

Baltimore's defense has historically been one of the team's biggest strengths, making last season's struggles particularly frustrating. The roster still contains enough established talent to rebound, while younger contributors have an opportunity to take larger roles. If those players develop quickly, the unit could look dramatically different from the one that struggled to consistently create momentum-changing plays.

Baltimore Ravens Predicted to Take a Leap in Defense for 2026 NFL Season

Baltimore is projected to level up their defense during the 2026 NFL season. This is detailed more in an analysis by Seth Walder for ESPN.

Bold prediction for 2026: The Ravens' defense will rank in the top four in EPA per play. That's a pretty big jump from last season, when it finished 16th. But in Minter's first season with the Chargers , he took a defense that ranked 29th and brought it to seventh best. And Minter probably has more talent to work with in Baltimore.

The potential impact extends beyond the statistics. More takeaways would give Lamar Jackson and the offense additional possessions, while a defense capable of getting off the field could reduce the pressure on Baltimore to win shootouts every week. That formula would be especially valuable in a competitive AFC, where small advantages can determine whether a team earns a favorable playoff position.

The prediction may sound ambitious, but Baltimore has the personnel and coaching change needed to make it realistic. If Minter's system clicks and the Ravens start consistently creating turnovers, their defense could become one of the biggest reasons the team makes a serious push in 2026 rather than another season defined by missed opportunities.

articles.title: Charlotte Hornets jersey history No. 1 Baron Davis 1999-2002
articles.summary: Baron Davis spent three seasons with the Charlotte Hornets before they relocated to New Orleans.
articles.body:
Charlotte Hornets guard Baron Davis was the second player in team history to wear No. 1 and was the fifth individual player to make an All-Star appearance for the franchise. Before a move to New Orleans , Davis spent three seasons in Charlotte after being selected with the No. 3 overall pick in the 1999 NBA Draft.

While he had a slow rookie campaign, Davis came alive in his third season, averaging 18.1 points, 8.5 assists, 4.3 rebounds, 2.1 steals and 0.6 blocks. During his three years with the franchise, the former UCLA guard averaged 12.6 points, 6.5 assists, 3.7 rebounds, 1.8 steals and 0.4 blocks. Following his time in Charlotte, Davis would perform exceptionally for both New Orleans and Golden State , earning MVP votes twice, once with each franchise. Throughout his 13-year career, Davis made two All-Star appearances, earned one All-NBA selection, and led the league in steals twice. In 835 games, Davis holds career averages of 16.1 points, 7.2 assists, 3.8 rebounds, 1.8 steals and 0.4 blocks.

articles.title: Seahawks overreactions: Jadarian Price proves Kenneth Walker won't be missed
articles.summary: The Seattle Seahawks proved they still have the defense to compete at a high level. But their running back room is still a work in progress. However, is it...
articles.body:
The Seattle Seahawks proved they still have the defense to compete at a high level. But their running back room is still a work in progress . However, is it an overreaction to say Jadarian Price proved Kenneth Walker won't be missed at all?

That's quite a stretch because Walker won the Super Bowl MVP award before departing the Seahawks via free agency and joining the Chiefs. However, if nothing else, Price looked good in Wednesday night's NFL season-opening win over the Patriots, according to a post on X by Brian Baldinger.

"@Jadarian15 showed the skills that made him the 2nd RB drafted…Solid debut…Exciting days to come. #BaldysBreakdowns"

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

Price carried 10 times for 52 yards. He also caught two passes for six more yards. Not a bad debut for the rookie.

Seahawks may have a keeper in RB Jadarian Price

He sure looked the part in Wednesday's game against the Patriots, according to sports.mynorthwest.com.

"I thought he ran the ball really well," Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said. "There's a couple plays that I'm thinking where we can talk about, maybe improve a little bit situationally, but I thought he had a really good start, and I'm excited about him.

"He should be proud of himself going in there with no preseason reps and taking care of the football. And staying square and making decisive cuts. I thought that was really cool."

Price also got an endorsement from Seattle Sports' Brock Huard.

"He was powerful," Huard said. "He was full of power. You felt his horsepower. Those are his first to-the-ground tackle plays in the NFL. And how many times did he go backwards? Zero. It was zero. How many times did he have contact at zero or 1 yard, and carry it for 2 or 3 more yards? Multiple times.

"How many times did he get there and hit his landmark on outside zone on the first drive of the game? I'm like, man, that is awesome. He is decisive, and then he's a little patient. And then he's explosive and powerful."

It certainly helped his standing across the league. He's now tied with Jeremiah Love as a favorite for NFL Offensive Rookie of the Year by Kalshi, according to Sports Illustrated.

However, one thing that Price needs is a quick return from Sam Darnold . Defenses will load up the box against Drew Locke, making it tougher for Price to find running room.

But back to the point, Price won't really be able to shake the shadow of Walker in the regular season. At least not this early. Perhaps if he keeps rolling deep into the regular season, it will help. But until he shows postseason juice, Seahawks fans are going to remember what Walker did for them in the Super Bowl.

This isn't a one-week deal to unseat the memory of Walker. As of now, he's still missed. But also, when Zach Charbonnet returns, it could muddy the picture for Price. Opportunities won't be as readily available. Charbonnet will get his touches, too.

So there's plenty of work to be done. It's a long NFL season.

articles.title: A.J. Brown injury update confirms return timeline for Patriots wide receiver
articles.summary: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown's timeline to return from an ankle injury has been revealed.
articles.body:
We now know how long New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown will be out with his ankle injury.

According to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport , Brown's high-ankle sprain has been confirmed after tests and he will miss four weeks.

With a four-week timeline, this will likely lead to his placement on injured reserve, although it's certainly possible the Pats hold off in the hope he can return sooner.

Brown suffered the injury in the third quarter of the Week 1 loss to the Seattle Seahawks on Wednesday night.

Now, the Patriots find themselves in a precarious spot, as they're extremely thin at wide receiver without Brown.

Romeo Doubs , who also made his Patriots debut on Wednesday night, will step into the WR1 role. The veteran wideout's stint with his new team got off to a tough start after he failed to reel in a single catch on three targets and had a drop.

The next most experienced wide receivers on the roster are veterans Mack Hollins , who is no more than a deep depth piece, and DeMario Douglas , who has two campaigns with over 500 receiving yards.

Beyond Hollins, Douglas and Doubs, there's Kyle Williams , who is unproven in his second season, and Efton Chism, who has just three catches in his brief career.

Safe to say, the Patriots need to explore their options in the trade and free-agent markets moving forward.

Former New York Giants wide receiver Darius Slayton immediately comes to mind as a potential option. He was cut loose by Big Blue earlier this week.

It sure would be nice to have Kayshon Boutte right now.

articles.title: Rams-49ers Thursday night game thread
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Rams and San Francisco 49ers both have the chance to start this year strong, or not.
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Rams "host" the San Franciso 49ers in Week 1 of the NFL season in Melbourne, Australia, in the first ever NFL game to be featured Down Under. This game is on Netflix, so you may want to check out our how to watch guide!

The Seattle Seahawks (1-0) won the first game of the season to sit atop the NFC West. The Rams and 49ers now have the chance to punch each other up as the winner of tonight's game will be 1-0 plus a division win. This is about as big an opening game as can be for SF and L.A.

Yes, the Rams have studs, we'll get to that, but don't count out the 49ers and Kyle Shanahan.

The 49ers come in with future Hall of Famer, Mike Evans , and should have its heart and soul of the defense back with Fred Warner . Christian McCaffrey will have the eyes of countless fantasy owners, bettors and 49ers fans everywhere as everyone wants to know if he can handle his workload in 2026.

The Mr. Irrelevant Brock Purdy has continued to be anything but irrelevant as a starting quarterback in the NFL. He'll look to continue to prove he's a top quarterback, and that he and Shanahan are a top duo in the league.

L.A. may have the best head coach in the NFL with Sean McVay, but as mentioned above, the Rams also have stars and studs to match their exciting HC.

Myles Garrett , Trent McDuffie , Matthew Stafford , Puka Nacua , just to name a few. Aaron Donald is back with the team, but will not be with the Rams today.

Donald not suiting up may be disappointing, but it also shouldn't be a reason the Rams lose if that's the outcome.

How the Rams traveled to Australia, however, will be discussed and studied whether the team wins or not. Travel is always a part of the NFL, but this game being in Australia makes the travel discussion more interesting than ever.

The 49ers took the approach of getting to Australia about a week before the game, the Rams took the approach of getting to Melbourne about a day before the game. Everyone wants to see how these teams look.

You aren't going to want to miss this one! Please join us for tonight's game thread and or consider checking out the SB Nation App! The more who join the merrier!

articles.summary: Myles Garrett and Mike Evans debuted with their new teams during Thursday night's Week 1 action in Australia.
articles.body:
Myles Garrett and Mike Evans debuted with their new teams during Thursday night's Week 1 action in Australia.

Garrett saw his first action with the Los Angeles Rams while Evans made his debut appearance with the San Francisco 49ers in Melbourne.

Thursday's matchup marked the NFL's first regular-season game in Australia.

Garrett played the first nine seasons of his NFL career with the Cleveland Browns before he was traded in June to the Rams.

He sat out his first preseason with the Rams while dealing with swelling in his knee.

Evans spent 12 seasons with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers before signing with the San Francisco 49ers.

He was similarly sidelined for the Niners' preseason due to minor groin, quad and adductor injuries .

Evans wasn't the only player to make Week 1 injury return for the 49ers.

Defensive end Nick Bosa, tight end George Kittle and linebacker Fred Warner were all active for the season opener after recovering from injuries that ended their 2025 seasons.

The only player ruled out for the Rams was Aaron Donald, who is still working his way toward an NFL comeback after last seeing action during the 2023 season.
